# ArchRay

> ArchRay is an AI-first architecture visualiser. Install it into a repository, type `/archray` in an AI coding assistant, and it turns real source evidence into a layered, interactive, offline 3D/2D single-file HTML architecture map.

## What it is

- Product: ArchRay (open source, MIT)
- Website: https://archray.dev/
- Repository: https://github.com/loofare/ArchRay
- Latest release: https://github.com/loofare/ArchRay/releases/latest
- Current public release: v0.5.0
- Maker: David Yin (https://davidyin.dev)

ArchRay is not runtime monitoring, not an automatic source scanner, and not a hosted diagram service. An AI agent performs the semantic reading; a deterministic engine computes layout, projections, and the single-file viewer.

## How it works

1. Install ArchRay in a repository once.
2. Open a new AI session and use `/archray`.
3. The AI records modules, layers, dependencies, source paths, flows, health findings and optional alternatives.
4. ArchRay validates the graph and builds `.archray/index.html`.
5. Open the HTML offline, or share the single file.

## Hosts

- Claude Code: `/archray`
- Cursor: `/archray`
- Antigravity: Skill; slash-command discovery depends on host version
- Pi: `/archray`, `/archray-frontend`, or `/skill:archray`
- Codex: `$archray` or `/skills`

## Install

```sh
tmp=$(mktemp)
if curl -fsSL https://github.com/loofare/ArchRay/releases/latest/download/install.sh -o "$tmp"; then
  sh "$tmp" . claude
  archray_install_status=$?
else
  archray_install_status=$?
fi
rm -f "$tmp"
test "$archray_install_status" -eq 0
```

Replace `claude` with `cursor`, `antigravity`, `pi`, `codex`, `claude,pi`, or `all`.

## Update and uninstall

```sh
./.archray/archray update --check
./.archray/archray update
./.archray/archray uninstall --dry-run
./.archray/archray uninstall
```

Updates refresh the tool, Skill, commands and templates. They do not re-analyse source and keep `.archray/graph.json`, `view.json` and `index.html`. `uninstall` keeps that data by default; `--purge` removes the whole `.archray`.

v0.4.0 and older have no `update` command; use the latest bootstrap once.

## Data boundary

- Source analysis happens in the AI assistant session the user authorises.
- Outputs stay in the local `.archray` directory.
- The HTML is self-contained and works over `file://`.
- Only an explicit `update` contacts GitHub Releases, reads `latest.json`, and verifies the archive by SHA-256.
- Health and replaceability are input-graph judgements, not runtime monitoring.
